u0: Initial state: the matching door key has not been acquired, so the locked door cannot be opened yet. The next objective is to locate and pick up the door-colored key; taking it advances to u1 and commits the agent to opening the door.
u1: The matching key has been acquired at least once, but the door has not yet been opened. If the key is currently held, go to the matching door and toggle it open; if it was dropped before opening, first recover it. Losing the key before the door opens keeps the machine in u1 and incurs a penalty. Opening the door advances to terminal u2.
u2: Terminal success: the door-opening obligation that followed taking the key has been fulfilled, and this final state is absorbing even if the door is later toggled shut. No further reward-machine objective remains; in the underlying MiniGrid mission, the remaining environmental objective is to go through the doorway and pick up the designated target box.
